observations.transcript: How can a clock tell a ship where it is? Sailors use the Sun to find local time corrected to match the clock's timekeeping. 12 at the reference. 2 in the afternoon locally. 2 hours ahead. 30 degrees east. The clock carries time. Observation and calculation reveal longitude.
